name: Lemon Garlic Baked Cod with Couscous

components.name: Lemon Garlic Cod

ingredients.name: Raw boneless cod fillets, thawed if frozen
Plain flour used for light coating

steps: Preheat oven to 200 C. Dry the fish carefully and distribute salt, coriander and paprika through the measured flour.
Lightly coat the fillets and shake off surplus flour; discard any coating that touched raw fish.
Melt butter and whisk with lemon, olive oil and minced garlic. Arrange fish in a single layer in a shallow oven dish and spoon sauce over it.
Bake until each thickest fillet reaches 63 C, normally 12-18 minutes depending on thickness; avoid extended holding in the warm oven.
Pack fish with its lemon cooking juices separately from couscous and finish with parsley after reheating.

components.name: Wholewheat Couscous

ingredients.name: Hot water or stock for couscous

steps: While fish bakes, pour hot water over dry couscous, cover until absorbed and fluff with a fork, then add measured oil and salt.
